mapper.sql: id, order_id, currency_code, receivable_type, receivable_amount, received_amount, due_date, receivable_status, overdue_days, owner_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_receivable WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM t_receivable WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_receivable (id, order_id, currency_code, receivable_type, receivable_amount, received_amount, due_date, receivable_status, overdue_days, owner_id, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{currencyCode}, #{receivableType}, #{receivableAmount}, #{receivedAmount}, #{dueDate}, #{receivableStatus}, #{overdueDays}, #{ownerId}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_receivable SET receivable_amount = #{receivableAmount}, received_amount = #{receivedAmount}, due_date = #{dueDate}, receivable_status = #{receivableStatus}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_receivable
ORDER BY due_date ASC, id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(receivable_amount - received_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS count FROM t_receivable WHERE deleted = 0 AND receivable_status != 'PAID' AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < CURDATE() GROUP BY bucket

SELECT
FROM t_receivable WHERE deleted = 0 AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < #{today} AND receivable_status != 'PAID' AND receivable_amount > received_amount ORDER BY due_date ASC, id ASC
